svg.text: Addition modulo 97 as rotation: the network’s own circle, as a slide rule
Cut out the ring and the disc, and pin the disc inside the ring at the centre marks.
Turn the disc so its 0 sits under a on the ring; the ring number over b on the disc is a + b (mod 97).
The numbers run 0, 27, 54, 81, 11, … around the circle: each step from t to t + 1 is 18/97 of a turn, the order read off the grokked network’s answers.
the ring: cut along the outer and inner circles
the disc: cut along the circle; its 0 is the pointer
